defect: _run_channel now calls fn(conn, query_text, k=topn) without as_of, so dense/fts/lemma run with their default as_of=None and scope_clause gates every channel candidate on today's date in Kyiv instead of the requested as_of; the as_of that hybrid() still passes in (line 209) is accepted at line 167 and silently discarded.
consequence: A caller who asks for the law as of a past date (the API accepts and validates as_of at api/main.py:36-54 and passes it through generate.py:278 -> search -> hybrid) gets channel candidates from the editions in force today: an edition that entered into force after as_of is served and, being in the closed candidate set, can be cited through the gate, while the edition actually in force on as_of is dropped from the channels. The exact route still honours as_of, so search() can return two editions of the same article side by side (its dedup key includes in_force_from). Nothing flags it: meta['degraded'] stays empty, build_candidates gets no as_of, and the hybrid and rerank modes of eval/retrieval_eval.py silently ignore gold as_of_date while its dense mode (line 126) still applies it.
proof: python -c from the tree root with unittest.mock recorders on R.dense/R.fts/R.lemma and a fake conn that records cursor.execute params: (A) R.hybrid(None, 'q', as_of='2020-01-01') -> channels received {'dense': None, 'fts': None, 'lemma': None}, degraded []; (B) the real fts via R._run_channel(conn, 'fts', 'q', '2020-01-01', 50, []) -> SQL param as_of = None; (B2) the pre-change call form R.fts(conn, 'q', '2020-01-01', k=50) -> SQL param as_of = '2020-01-01'; (C) R.search(None, 'q', as_of='2020-01-01', k=5) -> exact_lookup got '2020-01-01', channels got None. scope_clause('ci') is ci.in_force_from <= COALESCE(%(as_of)s::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv')::date) AND (ci.in_force_to IS NULL OR ci.in_force_to >= COALESCE(...)), so NULL means today. Worked case, as_of=2020-01-01: edition A in force 2015-01-01..2022-12-31 is served before the change and dropped after it (2022-12-31 >= today fails); edition B in force 2023-01-01..open is dropped before and served after (2023-01-01 <= today). The suite does not notice: unittest discover -s tests -p test_retrieval_offline.py -> Ran 15 tests, OK; the only hybrid() test (tests/test_retrieval_offline.py:102) passes no as_of, and tests/test_generate.py:76 and tests/test_api.py:110 stub search/generate above the channels.
